tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for taking part in this study. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your exercise habits. First, can you describe the type of exercise you or someone you know typically does regularly, such as running, yoga, or weightlifting? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你参与本次调研。今天我想请教一些关于你运动习惯的问题。首先，你可以描述一下你或你认识的人经常进行的运动类型吗，比如跑步、瑜伽或举重？为什么会选择这类运动？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Some exercise programs are done alone, and some are designed to be done with others. Would you prefer to exercise alone, or would you prefer to exercise with others? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。有些健身项目适合独自进行，有些则设计成多人一起完成。你更喜欢独自锻炼，还是和他人一起锻炼？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some people believe that exercising outdoors is both more beneficial and more enjoyable than exercising indoors. Do you agree or disagree and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：挺有意思的。有些人认为在户外锻炼比在室内锻炼更有益、也更令人愉悦。你同意还是不同意？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, I would like to ask about using fitness apps. Some people like to use fitness apps on smart phones to organize their fitness schedules. Do you agree this is a good way to keep track of your exercising goals? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得很有道理。最后，我想问问关于使用健身应用程序的问题。有些人喜欢用智能手机上的健身应用来安排健身计划。你是否认为这是追踪运动目标的好方法？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
